Is it true that X Y |γ ′ (0)| ≥ |γ(0)|2 ? γ∈Γ γ∈Γ, γ6=i Note that this is an equivalent formulation of a problem connecting the Bergman kernel function and the capacity function of a Riemann surface. artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{D}=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|<1\}$ denote the open unit disk, and let $\Gamma$ be a Fuchsian group acting on $\mathbb{D}$ (i.e., a discrete subgroup of the group of conformal automorphisms of $\mathbb{D}$). Let $i:\mathbb{D}\to\mathbb{D}$ be the identity map $i(z)\equiv z$. Determine whether the inequality
$$\sum_{\gamma\in\Gamma}|\gamma'(0)|\;\geq\;\prod_{\gamma\in\Gamma,\;\gamma\neq i}|\gamma(0)|^{2}$$
holds for every such $\Gamma$. (This inequality is an equivalent reformulation of the relation between the Bergman kernel function and the logarithmic capacity function on the associated Riemann surface $\mathbb{D}/\Gamma$.)
artifact.status_search_result: The question is the Suita conjecture, asserting $c_D^2\le\pi K_D$ on a Riemann surface. The inequality was proved by Błocki (2013) for bounded plane domains via the Ohsawa–Takegoshi extension theorem, and Guan–Zhou (2015) established it for general open Riemann surfaces, including the equality (rigidity) case. Hence the problem is solved.

status_evidence.snippet: The conjecture was first proved by Błocki (2013) for the bounded plane domain and then completely in a more generalized version by Guan & Zhou (2015).
